status: FROZEN GAME DEPTH CHART for preseason game 2 only; frozen August 13, 2014 before any draw. Not the working chart and not a role award.
sources: Stone's August 9 to 14 plan (Preseason Game 2_ HC.md): the opening correction lineup (Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Lucas at right tackle as a one-game assignment; Lewis and Kelce by package; Nicks, Thielen, Adams; Cousins; Branch opening Edge 1 for the one correction possession; Daryl Smith the communicator; Kreiter snapping first), the quarterback order (Cousins, Henne, Wilson, Bray, Shaw) and the medical decisions (Johnson does not play; Brate removed; Anderson plays if cleared, and he cleared August 11); the working depth chart (career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/working_depth_chart.json) for the rest; the camp record through August 13 for the players added but not placed, in the order of their recorded use; the current roster for control and availability.
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. Stone's plan sets the opening lineups through rotation.json, whose blocks lead their groups on the field; this order is a game-depth order for this preseason game only. Lucas is fifth among the linemen because he holds the first-group right tackle for this one game in Johnson's absence (Johnson sixth and inactive); nothing here changes Johnson's role or awards Lucas a place. Mincey stays first among the defensive linemen as the carried Edge 1 starting point and Cain first among the snappers as the carried place; the rotation puts Branch on the field for the correction possession and Kreiter in the opening operation, as the plan says, neither a promotion. Brate is listed last among the tight ends and inactive. The tight-end and reserve orders list the players in the order the camp record uses them and award no place; TE3 and the reserve corner remain open.

game_day_inactives.note: Preseason dresses the whole roster. Bradfield, Clemons, Brown and Pasztor are carried on the 78-player controlled roster on unsigned tenders, are not under contract, have not reported and may not practice or play until they sign: inactive by contract status, not by a medical instruction. Lane Johnson: out under the August 8 instruction (trunk, minor), reassessed August 10 with no change, projected return August 14, the game date; the roster rule would clear him on that date, and he is inactive by Stone's football decision in the plan, which holds him out of Chicago even if cleared late in the week. Cameron Brate: out, long term, under the August 8 instruction (removed from the game; projected return January 15, 2015), inactive by medical instruction and removed from the plan; roster disposition pending. C.J. Anderson cleared August 11, his projected date, took part normally in the preparation and is active. No other player is under a communicated medical instruction; August 9 to 13 communicated no injury or restriction. James Hurst is held on the undrafted board pending a medical clearance and is not a controlled player, so he cannot appear here.
